tools.name: weatherlink_list_stations
tools.description: List the weather stations your API Key can access, with their metadata. Start here to find a station id. WeatherLink v2: GET /v2/stations (or /v2/stations/{station-ids}).

tools.name: weatherlink_list_nodes
tools.description: List the nodes your API Key can access, with their metadata. WeatherLink v2: GET /v2/nodes (or /v2/nodes/{node-ids}).

tools.name: weatherlink_list_sensors
tools.description: List the sensors your API Key can access, with their metadata. WeatherLink v2: GET /v2/sensors (or /v2/sensors/{sensor-ids}).

tools.name: weatherlink_get_sensor_activity
tools.description: Get the last reporting time of sensors, to find sensors that stopped reporting. Leave sensor_ids empty for every sensor. WeatherLink v2: GET /v2/sensor-activity (or /v2/sensor-activity/{sensor-ids}).

tools.name: weatherlink_get_current_conditions
tools.description: Get the latest weather observation for one station, per sensor (for example temperature, humidity, wind and rain). How recent the record is depends on the access level: Pro+ gives the most recent record, Pro the most recent 5-minute record. WeatherLink v2: GET /v2/current/{station-id}.

tools.name: weatherlink_get_historic_data
tools.description: Get historic weather records for one station between two Unix times. The window can be at most 24 hours (86400 seconds). Each record's timestamp is the END of its recording interval. Access depends on the subscription level (Basic has no historic data). WeatherLink v2: GET /v2/historic/{station-id}.

tools.name: weatherlink_get_et_report
tools.description: Get the evapotranspiration (ET) data for one WeatherLink Live station. Only WeatherLink Live stations report ET. WeatherLink v2: GET /v2/report/et/{station-id}.
